payload.title: forgot password link is visible on the login form
payload.errorMessage:
Timed out 10000ms waiting for expect(locator).toBeVisible()

Locator: getByTestId('forgot-password-link')
Expected: visible
Received: <element(s) not found>

note: A 10-second timeout waiting for visibility is the textbook flaky shape. But the failure is 'element(s) not found', not 'found but hidden' — the locator never located a matching element in the DOM at all — and both attempts show that identical failure with no divergence between them, unlike this dataset's flaky-as-real-bug cases, where two failed attempts land on two different specific values. Consistently absent, not consistently slow, points to a recent auth redesign renaming the test-id from forgot-password-link to password-reset-link, not a rendering delay.
